syn: The default function for attributes is Call. Calling attributes will bring them to the encoder and select them in the fixture sheet (blue column header).
The default function for this object is Call. Calling a ButtonPage will change your physical executors to this page.
The ButtonPage keyword currently supports its default function Call only.
The default function for channel objects is SelFix. This means that entering channels without any specific function will select the channels in programmer.
For more information on default function for channel objects see
To use ChannelFader create a ChannelPage first. For more information on how to create a channel page see
The default function of ChannelPage is Call. Calling a ChannelPage will change the executor faders to channel mode.
For more information on the default function of ChannelPage see

Cue is the only object type that accepts numerical ID as decimal fractions. The ID allowed for cues ranges from 0.001 to 9999.999. In all other objects a dot indicates the ID of a parent or a child object.
The default function for cue objects is SelFix. This means that calling cues without any specific function selects the fixtures of the cue.
Entering a DMX address opens the DMX encoder bar which may be used for testing. You may also set a test level directly by combining the DMX address with the keyword
The keyword DmxUniverse may be used to access DMX universes or all DMX channels of a universe.
